summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd., a Bermuda-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, disclosing a mandatory notification of trade by a PDMR. Contracted CFO Vidar Hasund sold 100,000 shares at an average price of NOK 149.31 per share on Oslo Bors, a sale worth approximately NOK 14.931 million, leaving him with no shares and only 20,000 share options. The filing is procedural, required under MAR and Norwegian securities law, and involves no corporate event. It has no impact on the company's operations or capital structure. No further action or special-situation consideration is warranted.
